Compare several choice models side by side

Source: R/compare.R
compare_models.Rd

Compare several choice models side by side

Usage

compare_models(...)

Arguments

...

Named or unnamed "choicemodel" fits.

Value

A data frame of class "compare_models" with one row per model: the model type, inflated alternative, cases, parameters, log-likelihood, AIC, BIC, McFadden R-squared, and the converged, boundary, and ill_conditioned flags and n_modes; with a penalized fit among them a penalized column, and the print notes that their log-likelihoods and criteria are at the penalized estimates, not maximum-likelihood ones.

See also

vuong(), lr_test(), fit_stats()

Other model comparison: boot_lr_test(), classification(), fit_stats(), lr_test(), vuong()

Examples

set.seed(2)
d <- rmnl(1000, beta = cbind(b = c(0.5, -1, 0.8), c = c(-0.3, 0.6, -0.5)),
          delta = c(0.5, 1.2), inflate = "a")
compare_models(mnl = mnl(y ~ x1 + x2, data = d),
               imnl = imnl(y ~ x1 + x2 | z1, data = d, inflate = "a"))
#>  model                                                              type
#>    mnl                                                 Multinomial logit
#>   imnl Inflated multinomial logit (inflated alternative: a, logit split)
#>  inflate    n df   loglik      AIC      BIC mcfadden converged boundary
#>          1000  6 -857.498 1726.996 1756.443    0.117      TRUE    FALSE
#>        a 1000  8 -792.033 1600.065 1639.327    0.185      TRUE    FALSE
#>  ill_conditioned n_modes
#>            FALSE       1
#>            FALSE       1
